invariants.rationale: The restore method always returns the result of 'execute()', which is expected to produce a non-null HoodieRestoreMetadata on a successful restore.
A valid restore operation requires a non-null, non-empty restore instant timestamp.
A valid restore operation typically requires a non-null, non-empty savepoint timestamp to define the restore boundary.
The context is essential for execution and is expected to be non-null for any engine operation.
